title: Captions write themselves from the speech
goal: Captions today are a button and a paragraph. They should be written automatically from the speech, on this Mac, onto a captions track, where a person can edit and style them and export them burned in or as a subtitle file.
notes:
Intake detail (the goal as first filed, moved here by triage 2026-09-23): User asks 2026-09-23: 'add captioning' and 'auto extract captions'. Today captions are a Write Captions button and a paragraph in the panel (CaptionsInspector.swift); see mock video-captions.html. Target: the user's mocks (docs/design/mocks/pages/video.html, video-shell.html, comp-video.html and the page named here) at their fidelity; runner-prompt rules on default config, side-by-side with the mock, labels-not-explanations and right-click apply. Ask throughout: would a Premiere editor get this, and is it easier here?

Filed from the 2026-09-23 video audit in the intake window.
acceptance: When a recording with speech opens, captions are transcribed on this Mac in the background (no button needed) and land on a Captions track as timed segments; a single toggle turns this off
Each caption segment is editable in place on the timeline and on the canvas, and its edges drag to retime
A caption style (font, size, colour, background, position) applies to all, from one row in the panel
Export: burned in, or as an SRT/VTT file beside the video
Walk at Next defaults opens a recording with speech and photographs captions appearing without a click

Pre-build review. Today: Write button in the panel, captions land as a group whose timeline draws ONE ROW PER CAPTION (a staircase down the dock, see /tmp walk 4-a-caption-on-the-picture-sc.png), white text with shadow only, SRT only, nothing automatic. Mock (video-captions.html): one Caption track row of cues side by side plus a Words lane of chips with the active word lit; Properties has Language dropdown, Generate: Auto captions, Cue section (In/Out/Dur/Words), Caption style segmented Caption / Lower third / Karaoke; canvas cue on a dark plate with the active word yellow. Premiere test: Premiere puts captions on one captions track, edits text in place on the track and the Program monitor, restyles all via track style, exports sidecar SRT or burn-in. Gaps the app can deliver in this task: auto-run on open, one-track layout (caption group reads as a captions-track clip, children drawn side by side), per-word highlight at render time, text plate (background), style presets applied to all, VTT, inline edit on the timeline bar. Risks: auto-run on every open of a doc someone cleared (must remember it listened), auto-run on music makes noise (auto runs stay quiet when nothing heard), long recordings (existing chunked, stoppable listener).
